status: native coordinator checks required live cancellation guard before dispatch and cache commit in isolated fixture
reason: BlobExchange currently checks request cancellation only after its asynchronous planner finishes; a planner that commits early needs that guard at its own commit boundary
verified: same-account held model result is cancelled by changed request generation and leaves cache bytes unchanged
existing account-switch, erasure, busy and shutdown coordinator checks pass with real V8 and synthetic profile
limitations: BlobExchange does not currently pass its final controller/queue dispatch guard into async planners; do not hook this coordinator to production transport yet
remote payload still requires authentication and account binding by credential broker
guard must be called on same owning sequence, must not reenter coordinator, and must reflect actual lifecycle/generation; unqualified caller can supply a dishonest guard
app, real network, renderer and platform integration and Windows/Linux tests remain open
